name: Katagiri Sayaka
source:
She lives with her son, who has just started high school, in an old apartment. She works part time at a local supermarket.

Although she lives a modest life, she is content with the life she has, and as a mother, she is content with her life as it is now.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/sayaka/sayaka.html]official site[/url]]
